label: Real GDP
definition: Gross domestic product at basic prices, all industries, Canada. Monthly, seasonally adjusted at annual rates, chained (2017) dollars.

label: Retail sales
definition: Total retail trade sales, Canada. Monthly, seasonally adjusted, current dollars.

label: Unemployment rate
definition: Unemployment rate, population aged 15 and over, Canada (Labour Force Survey). Monthly, seasonally adjusted, percent.

label: CPI
definition: Consumer Price Index, all-items, Canada. Monthly, not seasonally adjusted, 2002=100.

label: Policy rate
definition: Target for the overnight rate, the Bank of Canada's policy interest rate. Business daily, percent.

label: USD/CAD
definition: USD/CAD daily average exchange rate, Canadian dollars per US dollar. Business daily.

label: 2-year bond yield
definition: Yield on the Government of Canada 2-year benchmark bond. Business daily, percent.

label: 10-year bond yield
definition: Yield on the Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond. Business daily, percent.
